verdict.rationale: Teleoperation is a fair axis for a robotics platform. The only relevant evidence is a passing mention that Isaac Sim can ingest real-world captures via Isaac TeleOp. That implies a teleoperation component exists, but only as a data-capture source for simulation. Missing for 10: live video streaming from a remote robot, responsive low-latency control, operation over real-world networks, and any docs or hands-on corroboration of an ops teleoperation workflow.
